need: Hazard: the Vietnamese twin of the same Foreword, in the full 584-page book. The 40 000-character index cap falls inside this volume's table of contents, so nothing of its body — the Foreword at character 78 190 included — is indexed, while the English twin's Foreword sits at character 5 681 and is. The pair is the cleanest reading of what the cap does to a translation: same paragraph, one language in the index and the other out.
